title: "import/exports-last"
description: "Require all exports to come after every other statement in the file"

When exports are spread through a file, you have to read all of it to learn what it offers. With every export at the bottom, the last lines of the file are its public interface.

An export is reported if any statement that isn't an export comes after it. This applies to every kind: `export const`, `export function`, `export default`, `export { }` and `export * from`.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"import/exports-last" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```js
export const retries = 3;

function wait(ms) {
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export { wait };
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
const retries = 3;

function wait(ms) {
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export { retries, wait };
```

{/* good */}
```js
const cache = new Map();

export const retries = 3;
export function clear() {
  cache.clear();
}
export default cache;
```
